policy: Only epoch0 may add absent targetId/ability metadata; complete epoch1 may add declared epoch2 critical metadata/Focus producer. Wrong or deleted current-epoch metadata and arbitrary effects reject. Exact declared payload pairs reverse to unchanged historical early-combat hashes. Epoch3 adds only five literal rule fields and the source-pinned GenV SweetScent Eva-1 correction; complete epoch3 inputs may not lose either. Legacy hashes remain unchanged. Epoch4 explicitly adds Bide117 for originalBlue TM34; exact added row is independently source-qualified and removed only from the historical424-row hash projection. Arbitrary extra rows and mutations of the added row reject. Epoch5 adds only Captivate oppositeSex attempt eligibility; its existing SpA-2 effect and every scalar remain unchanged. Per-rule introduction epochs protect complete old versions and reject current deletions. Epoch6 adds only SolarBeam/SkullBash chargeRule and PetalDance lockRule, with all prior scalar/effect bytes retained. Epoch7 introduces only RainDance WeatherEffect and Thunder/Hurricane weatherAccuracy booleans; exact payload inverse and current metadata checks preserve original scalar/effect hashes. Epoch8 adds only WorrySeed attemptRule and exact WorrySeedEffect producer; all existing fields and historical hashes remain protected. Epoch9 adds only two exact source-projected booleans on all425 rows and ProtectEffect. The original immutable ability metadata artifact and historical scalar/effect hashes remain unchanged. AddedBide must validate both exact new flags before projecting its unchanged legacy row. Epoch10 adds only LightScreen/Safeguard/Tailwind typed side-condition payloads; Gen5 PP30/25/30, all425 original scalars/targets/flags/prior fields and original historical hashes retained. Epoch11 replaces only the exact Roost generic floor-half payload with RoostEffect, owning successful half-up healing and transient effective typing; all425 scalars, PP10, target7, flags, other payloads and original historical hashes stay exact. Epoch12 corrects only PoisonFang from modern50-percent ordinary poison to source-pinned Gen5 30-percent badPoison; all scalar/PP/target/protection fields retained. Exact forward-only declared payload chains permit complete historical input migration; current-epoch rollback/deletion and undeclared intermediate payloads still reject. Original424 inverse and immutable oracles unchanged.
